nodes.label: rshot Plan 1: Foundation + Linux Screenshots
nodes.rationale: Goal: daily-usable rshot on Ubuntu 24.04 / GNOME 46 / X11 (Print, Shift+Print, Alt+Print), file in ~/Pictures/Screenshots, clipboard holds path+file+image, Glass overlay, thumbnail, onboarding, settings, .deb. Editor, recording and Windows/macOS deferred to Plans 2-4.

nodes.label: rshot Plan 2: Image Editor
nodes.rationale: Goal: clicking the thumbnail or tray Open Last Capture opens the Glass editor (mockup 03) with arrow, rect, ellipse, line, pen, highlighter, text, step counter, redact, crop, undo/redo, zoom; Done writes the flattened PNG over the same file and re-copies the clipboard. No new dependencies.

nodes.label: Single resident Tauri process with tray
nodes.rationale: One resident process keeps hidden preloaded overlays per monitor and owns the clipboard, so a keypress only has to forward a CLI call rather than start an app.
nodes.norm_label: single resident tauri process with tray

nodes.label: Single-instance CLI forwarding
nodes.rationale: GNOME custom keybindings run `rshot capture ...`; the single-instance plugin forwards argv to the resident process, which dispatches it.

nodes.label: Preloaded hidden per-monitor overlay windows
nodes.rationale: Preloading hits the <=250 ms key-to-visible target; if idle memory exceeds 200 MB the fallback stops preloading and destroys windows on hide.

nodes.label: Frozen frames as raw RGBA via binary IPC (overlay_frame)
nodes.rationale: Raw RGBA avoids PNG encode/decode on the hot path; if latency fails, the controller chooses between PNG frames, downscaled preview frames or a native overlay.
nodes.norm_label: frozen frames as raw rgba via binary ipc (overlay_frame)

nodes.label: Performance and focus gate (spec §5, docs/perf.md)
nodes.rationale: Measure key->visible <=250 ms, overlay focus, Esc hides, idle memory <=200 MB; apply only the matching fallback; on latency failure stop BLOCKED with a breakdown instead of guessing.

nodes.label: ui::force_focus (X server timestamp present)
nodes.rationale: Fallback for GNOME/Mutter focus-stealing prevention: stamp the X server time before presenting the overlay.

nodes.label: Glass style tokens (style A, glass.css)
nodes.rationale: accent #0a84ff, glass rgba(40,40,46,.68) + blur(24px) saturate(180%), Inter font; mockups are the visual contract.

nodes.label: Linux-only cfg gating, compile on Windows/macOS
nodes.rationale: Only Ubuntu 24.04/GNOME 46/X11 is tested at runtime, but code must compile everywhere, so x11rb, gsettings, pw-play and X11 clipboard formats are #[cfg(target_os = "linux")].
nodes.norm_label: linux-only cfg gating, compile on windows/macos

nodes.label: AppState (config, clipboard, last_capture, session, pending, thumb)
nodes.norm_label: appstate (config, clipboard, last_capture, session, pending, thumb)

nodes.label: Capture naming Screenshot_YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS.png (unique_path, new_screenshot_path)
nodes.rationale: No spaces in names; same-second collisions add _2, _3; folder defaults to <XDG Pictures>/Screenshots.

nodes.label: store::write_atomic (temp file + rename)
nodes.rationale: Files are always written atomically: temp in the same directory, then rename, so no half-written capture or config is ever visible.

nodes.label: clipboard::Clipboard owner thread (copy_capture, copy_image)
nodes.rationale: The resident process owns the clipboard so X11 selections stay served after the capture command returns.

nodes.label: Clipboard payload: path + image vs path only
nodes.rationale: Always the absolute path (never ~). Path+image mode offers UTF8_STRING, text/plain variants, text/uri-list, x-special/gnome-copied-files and image/png so terminals get the path, chat apps the image and Files a copy; path-only drops the last three.
nodes.norm_label: clipboard payload: path + image vs path only

nodes.label: capture.rs (grab_all, frame_at, clamp_rect, crop, encode_png, windows_on, window_image)
nodes.norm_label: capture.rs (grab_all, frame_at, clamp_rect, crop, encode_png, windows_on, window_image)

nodes.label: play_shutter (pw-play shutter.wav)
nodes.rationale: Linux plays via pw-play; Windows/macOS stub until Plan 4 (ponytail comment).

nodes.label: selection.ts geometry (fromPoints, clamp, move, resize, handleAt, windowAt)
nodes.norm_label: selection.ts geometry (frompoints, clamp, move, resize, handleat, windowat)

nodes.label: Timer countdown window (overlay::Pending)
nodes.rationale: Overlay hides and a ring counts down on the live screen so menus opened during the countdown land in the capture.

nodes.label: ui::popup / close_prefix / POPUP_SEQ
nodes.rationale: Popups get unique labels (thumbnail-7, countdown-8) because a label can't be reused until destroy completes; old ones are closed by prefix.

nodes.label: Floating thumbnail (thumbnail.rs, Thumb)
nodes.rationale: Glass card bottom-right for 5 s; click opens default viewer in Plan 1 (Plan 2 routes it to the editor); drag-out, reveal, delete, swipe.

nodes.label: thumbnail::guard path guard
nodes.rationale: Security: only files rshot saved (inside the screenshots dir or the canonical last capture) may be read, opened or deleted from a webview.

nodes.label: thumbnail::tildify
nodes.rationale: Display only; the clipboard keeps the absolute path.

nodes.label: GNOME shortcut takeover/restore (shortcuts::take_over, restore)
nodes.rationale: Backs up GNOME keybindings into Config.gnome_backup before rebinding Print keys to rshot; restore clears it. Only rshot's own code may touch user keybindings; leave the desktop as found.

nodes.label: rshot restore-shortcuts (restore_from_cli)
nodes.rationale: Handled before Tauri starts so it works without the resident app; used by the deb prerm and by testers to leave the desktop as found.

nodes.label: Tray menu (Open Last Capture, Open Screenshots Folder, Settings, Quit)
nodes.norm_label: tray menu (open last capture, open screenshots folder, settings, quit)

nodes.label: CI workflow Linux/Windows/macOS (ci.yml)
nodes.rationale: clippy -D warnings everywhere, never a blanket allow; cross-check.sh type-checks Windows/macOS locally so cfg errors surface before CI.

nodes.label: Debian package (.deb), self-sufficient
nodes.rationale: May depend only on libraries every stock Ubuntu desktop has; anything else is bundled.

nodes.label: deb prerm.sh (restore shortcuts on uninstall)
nodes.rationale: Gives Print keys back to GNOME for every logged-in user (best effort), not on upgrade.

nodes.label: Autonomous run environment notes (no sudo, xdo.py)
nodes.rationale: User away: do the closest safe thing instead of asking; no sudo so xdotool is replaced by scripts/xdo.py and the .deb is inspected with dpkg-deb rather than installed.
nodes.norm_label: autonomous run environment notes (no sudo, xdo.py)

nodes.label: editor.rs commands (open_editor, editor_info, save_image, editor_delete, copy_path)
nodes.norm_label: editor.rs commands (open_editor, editor_info, save_image, editor_delete, copy_path)

nodes.label: save_image (raw PNG IPC body)
nodes.rationale: Takes the flattened PNG as InvokeBody::Raw, writes it atomically over the opened file and re-copies the clipboard.

nodes.label: ui::open_editor (one undecorated window per file)
nodes.rationale: 80% of the monitor, centred; opening the same file again focuses the existing window instead of a second one.

nodes.label: Path guard accepts open editor files (allowed(p, last, open))
nodes.rationale: Plan 1 Task 9 security ruling only allowed the last capture; editors must keep working after a new capture replaces 'last', so guard becomes pub(crate) and also accepts paths open in an editor.
nodes.norm_label: path guard accepts open editor files (allowed(p, last, open))

nodes.label: Thumbnail Edit button and click open the editor
nodes.norm_label: thumbnail edit button and click open the editor

nodes.label: Tray Open Last Capture routes to editor
nodes.norm_label: tray open last capture routes to editor

nodes.label: model.ts pure document model (Shape, Doc, hitTest, handles, exportOrder)
nodes.rationale: Pure and unit-tested first (17 tests) so interaction and rendering build on verified geometry.
nodes.norm_label: model.ts pure document model (shape, doc, hittest, handles, exportorder)

nodes.label: Vector shapes in image-pixel coordinates until export
nodes.rationale: Shapes stay editable (move/resize/restyle, undo) and zoom-independent; flattening happens only at export.
nodes.norm_label: vector shapes in image-pixel coordinates until export

nodes.label: exportOrder: redactions first, then shapes in z-order
nodes.rationale: Redactions sample the original pixels, so they must paint before annotations that could otherwise be pixelated into them.
nodes.norm_label: exportorder: redactions first, then shapes in z-order

nodes.label: render.ts Canvas 2D drawing and export (drawDoc, exportPng)
nodes.norm_label: render.ts canvas 2d drawing and export (drawdoc, exportpng)

nodes.label: redact (pixelate / blur / solid from original pixels)
nodes.rationale: Redaction must change exported pixels: pixelate/blur resample the original through a small canvas and the PNG is flattened, so the original content can't be recovered.
nodes.norm_label: redact (pixelate / blur / solid from original pixels)

nodes.label: styles.ts per-tool style state and popover (SECTIONS)
nodes.norm_label: styles.ts per-tool style state and popover (sections)

nodes.label: Editor interaction main.ts (tools, selection, text, crop, zoom, save/close)
nodes.norm_label: editor interaction main.ts (tools, selection, text, crop, zoom, save/close)

nodes.label: Editor tools and keys (V C A R O L P H T N B)
nodes.norm_label: editor tools and keys (v c a r o l p h t n b)

nodes.label: Image unit min(2, max(1, min(W,H)/1080)) (unitFor)
nodes.rationale: Stroke widths and text sizes scale with image resolution so annotations look the same on HiDPI and normal captures.

nodes.label: Step counter auto-numbering (nextCounter)
nodes.rationale: Next number follows the highest existing one (delete 2 of 1-2-3, next is 4), not the first gap.

nodes.label: Done / Ctrl+S / Enter saves in place and re-copies
nodes.rationale: The editor always saves over the file it opened so the path already in the clipboard never changes; Copy saves if dirty but stays open.
nodes.norm_label: done / ctrl+s / enter saves in place and re-copies

nodes.label: Unsaved changes prompt (requestClose, Esc order)
nodes.rationale: Esc deselects first, then closes; closing dirty asks Save changes?; delete asks confirmation.

nodes.label: Simplification: pen/highlighter/text/counter move but don't resize
nodes.rationale: Their handles list is empty; resizing text is done through the size setting in the popover.
nodes.norm_label: simplification: pen/highlighter/text/counter move but don't resize

nodes.label: Clipboard contract (path + file + image)
nodes.rationale: rshot's differentiator: every capture puts its absolute path on the clipboard with the file and image. X11 loses the clipboard when its owner exits, so the daemon owns it.

nodes.label: Atomic write (temp file + rename)
nodes.rationale: Captures and editor/trim saves are written to a temp file then renamed, so a failed save leaves the original untouched and the path never changes.

nodes.label: Crash-safe MKV capture remuxed to MP4
nodes.rationale: ffmpeg records into a hidden .Recording_*.mkv because MKV survives a crash; on stop it is remuxed to .mp4 with -c copy. If ffmpeg dies the MKV is kept and the user notified.
nodes.norm_label: crash-safe mkv capture remuxed to mp4

nodes.label: Bundled static ffmpeg sidecar (externalBin)
nodes.rationale: Installers must be self-sufficient and depend only on libraries every stock desktop has, so every platform ships a pinned static ffmpeg build.

nodes.label: OS screenshot shortcut takeover and restore
nodes.rationale: rshot replaces the OS screenshot tool with consent and must give the keys back cleanly; restore-shortcuts runs without a daemon for uninstallers.
nodes.norm_label: os screenshot shortcut takeover and restore

nodes.label: Windows takeover: registry + WH_KEYBOARD_LL hook
nodes.rationale: RegisterHotKey can't claim Win+Shift+S, which the shell owns, so a low-level keyboard hook swallows the combos.

nodes.label: Preloaded overlay windows
nodes.rationale: On-demand overlays measured about 500 ms latency with lost focus, so the overlays stay preloaded and memory is measured as PSS.

nodes.label: Pure no-I/O functions for unit tests
nodes.rationale: Naming, crop math, gsettings list edits, ffmpeg args, clipboard payload and config defaults are plain functions with no I/O so they can be unit-tested.
nodes.norm_label: pure no-i/o functions for unit tests

nodes.label: Video trim editor (spec 2.7)
nodes.rationale: Done re-encodes the kept range frame-accurately to a temp file and renames it over the original, so the path stays the same.

nodes.label: Webview hardening: CSP + per-window command allow-lists
nodes.rationale: Plan 1 final-review ruling: had to land before the asset protocol. Every command is declared in build.rs AppManifest and granted only in the capability file of the window label that calls it.
nodes.norm_label: webview hardening: csp + per-window command allow-lists

nodes.label: Video delivery via Tauri asset protocol (per-file scope)
nodes.rationale: Never scope whole folders: a webview can change the screenshots folder, so one file is granted at a time. Later superseded by the loopback range server.
nodes.norm_label: video delivery via tauri asset protocol (per-file scope)

nodes.label: Recording watchdog thread
nodes.rationale: Ticks the tray timer; if ffmpeg dies on its own it keeps the MKV and tells the user.

nodes.label: Graceful ffmpeg stop (q on stdin, 10 s deadline, then kill)
nodes.norm_label: graceful ffmpeg stop (q on stdin, 10 s deadline, then kill)

nodes.label: rshot-ffmpeg sidecar naming
nodes.rationale: Named rshot-ffmpeg, never ffmpeg, so the .deb installs /usr/bin/rshot-ffmpeg without clashing with the distro ffmpeg.

nodes.label: WH_KEYBOARD_LL hook with 0xE8 dummy key
nodes.rationale: After swallowing a Super combo the hook sends a dummy key (0xE8) so releasing Win doesn't open Start.

nodes.label: macOS simple-fullscreen overlays
nodes.rationale: Simple fullscreen gives a borderless window over the menu bar with no new Space or animation, unlike set_fullscreen.

nodes.label: macOS template tray icon + tooltip timer
nodes.rationale: Windows has no tray title, so the recording timer is also written to the tray tooltip on every OS.
nodes.norm_label: macos template tray icon + tooltip timer

nodes.label: Cross-check verification (clippy for Windows/macOS targets)
nodes.rationale: Nothing can run on the Linux dev machine, so correctness comes from unit tests of pure parts, cross-target clippy and the owner's smoke tests.

nodes.label: Platform differences behind #[cfg(target_os)] in owning modules
nodes.norm_label: platform differences behind #[cfg(target_os)] in owning modules

nodes.label: Spec 5 perf targets recalibrated
nodes.rationale: Closing the last ~5% of latency and memory needs a native (non-WebView) overlay, which is out of scope. Measured mean ~229 ms; memory measured as PSS.

nodes.label: Loopback HTTP range server for video preview
nodes.rationale: WebKitGTK 2.52 can't play <video> from asset:// and the blob fallback loads the whole file into memory. std-only server on 127.0.0.1 with a per-editor 128-bit token, Host check, single range, 32-connection cap.
nodes.norm_label: loopback http range server for video preview

nodes.label: Poster PNG + duration thumbnail for videos
nodes.norm_label: poster png + duration thumbnail for videos

nodes.label: Pill mic level meter (astats/ametadata)
nodes.rationale: Built despite Plan 3 dropping it: spec 2.6 and mockup 04 show it and the plan's claimed ruling didn't exist.

nodes.label: One universal macOS dmg with lipo'd ffmpeg
nodes.rationale: The spec says universal; Plan 4 had per-arch dmgs.
nodes.norm_label: one universal macos dmg with lipo'd ffmpeg

nodes.label: combo::takeable rule (Ctrl/Alt/Super required unless Print)
nodes.rationale: Takeover and the Settings recorder disagreed: Shift+letter swallowed capitals and a bare F-key rolled the takeover back.

nodes.label: GNOME restore resets keys to defaults
nodes.norm_label: gnome restore resets keys to defaults

nodes.label: Trust the observed value on first takeover (+ macOS defaults-domain backup copy)
nodes.rationale: Re-enabling what a user had disabled (ShareX/Greenshot) is worse; reverses the Plan 4 T3 lost-config ruling.
nodes.norm_label: trust the observed value on first takeover (+ macos defaults-domain backup copy)

nodes.label: Quit/uninstall release keys but keep consent (--keep-consent)
nodes.rationale: Upgrades no longer switch the takeover off; RunEvent::Exit (Cmd+Q, logout, sign-out) also releases keys and stops ffmpeg.
nodes.norm_label: quit/uninstall release keys but keep consent (--keep-consent)

nodes.label: Ad-hoc signing with hardenedRuntime off (macOS)
nodes.rationale: The hardened runtime needs the audio-input entitlement for mic capture and adds nothing without notarization.

nodes.label: GPL licensing items deferred to owner
nodes.norm_label: gpl licensing items deferred to owner

nodes.label: Path-only clipboard mode serves text targets only
nodes.norm_label: path-only clipboard mode serves text targets only

nodes.label: Skip image/png above 15 MiB on X11
nodes.rationale: clipboard-rs has no INCR support, so a bigger property silently breaks clipboard serving for good.
nodes.norm_label: skip image/png above 15 mib on x11

nodes.label: Opaque popups instead of blurred glass
nodes.rationale: WebKitGTK can't blur the desktop behind a window.
nodes.norm_label: opaque popups instead of blurred glass

nodes.label: Coarser redaction block size
nodes.rationale: The brief's floor left text readable in WebKitGTK; spec requires unrecoverable redaction.

nodes.label: Unremuxable interrupted recording becomes visible Recording_*.mkv
nodes.norm_label: unremuxable interrupted recording becomes visible recording_*.mkv

nodes.label: Override-redirect frame and pill on Linux
nodes.rationale: Skips GNOME's fade/animation in recordings and screenshots; cost: the pill can't take keyboard focus.
nodes.norm_label: override-redirect frame and pill on linux

nodes.label: Packages recommend GStreamer H.264 codecs for the trimmer
nodes.norm_label: packages recommend gstreamer h.264 codecs for the trimmer

nodes.label: Linux built on ubuntu-24.04 (glibc 2.39)
nodes.rationale: libspa 0.10.1 (xcap -> pipewire) doesn't compile against PipeWire 0.3.48 headers on ubuntu-22.04.

nodes.label: Subagent-driven run: implementer + reviewer per task, one fix wave per plan
nodes.norm_label: subagent-driven run: implementer + reviewer per task, one fix wave per plan

nodes.label: ffmpeg PR_SET_PDEATHSIG via spawner thread
nodes.rationale: A killed rshot left ffmpeg recording invisibly: a privacy and disk risk.

nodes.label: Windows Job object kills ffmpeg with rshot (no macOS equivalent)
nodes.norm_label: windows job object kills ffmpeg with rshot (no macos equivalent)

nodes.label: Keep rshot's own UI out of captures (clear_own_ui)
nodes.rationale: Frame, pill and thumbnail card must never land in a grab; costs about +150 ms when a card or area recording is on screen.
nodes.norm_label: keep rshot's own ui out of captures (clear_own_ui)

nodes.label: WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER=1 default on Linux
nodes.rationale: An NVIDIA driver/library mismatch made WebKitGTK abort with GBM EGL errors.

nodes.label: Invalid config.toml moved aside to config.toml.invalid
nodes.rationale: The plan's code overwrote an invalid config and lost gnome_backup; shortcuts must stay restorable.
nodes.norm_label: invalid config.toml moved aside to config.toml.invalid

nodes.label: Pinned dated ffmpeg builds with sha256 check
nodes.rationale: `latest` rebuilds daily; spec 3.7 requires pinned URLs checked against a sha256.
nodes.norm_label: pinned dated ffmpeg builds with sha256 check

nodes.label: Absolute file path on clipboard
nodes.rationale: Every capture puts its absolute path on the clipboard next to the image, so a terminal or AI agent gets a path and a chat app gets the picture.

nodes.label: System screenshot shortcut takeover
nodes.rationale: rshot replaces the OS screenshot tool shortcuts included; PrtScn on Windows and Cmd+Shift+5 on macOS always open the overlay.

nodes.label: rshot restore-shortcuts command
nodes.rationale: Gives the OS its shortcuts back; needed explicitly for AppImage and macOS drag-to-Trash, which run no uninstaller.

nodes.label: Windows keyboard hook (UIPI, 0xE8 dummy key)
nodes.rationale: Elevated windows are invisible to the hook (UIPI); Ctrl+Alt+letter also swallows AltGr+letter; 0xE8 dummy key prevents Start/menu opening on Win/Alt release.

nodes.label: macOS symbolic hotkeys (activateSettings -u, hotkeyBackup)
nodes.rationale: Giving keys back re-enables Cmd+Shift+3/4/5 with default keys, losing user remaps; a backup is kept in rshot's own defaults.

nodes.label: Screen recording flow (3 s countdown, MP4 H.264)
nodes.norm_label: screen recording flow (3 s countdown, mp4 h.264)

nodes.label: rshot-ffmpeg bundled sidecar
nodes.rationale: Ships its own ffmpeg so nothing else needs installing for recording and trimming.

nodes.label: Trimmer loopback video server (127.0.0.1)
nodes.rationale: Windows WebView2 Local Network Access / macOS ATS may block it; then 'Can't play this video here' is shown but file and copied path are unaffected.

nodes.label: Linux packages need glibc 2.39 (Ubuntu 24.04 build)
nodes.rationale: Built on Ubuntu 24.04 because the screen-capture library's PipeWire bindings need PipeWire >= 1.0 headers at build time.

nodes.label: Owner smoke test checklist (Windows and macOS)
nodes.rationale: Windows and macOS builds are compiled by CI but were never run by the implementer.
nodes.norm_label: owner smoke test checklist (windows and macos)

nodes.label: Licensing gaps before first public release
nodes.rationale: Other GPL libraries are only pinned by build scripts; lame/xvid licence files missing from notices; macOS notices derived from BtbN pins.
nodes.norm_label: licensing gaps before first public release

nodes.label: Develop prerequisites (Rust stable, Node 22, apt libs)
nodes.norm_label: develop prerequisites (rust stable, node 22, apt libs)

nodes.label: GPLv3 licence of bundled FFmpeg (FFMPEG-LICENSE.txt)
nodes.rationale: FFmpeg is used unmodified as a separate program, keeping rshot itself MIT.

nodes.label: key -> visible overlay latency target (<= 250 ms)
nodes.rationale: Accepted at mean ~229 ms, 34/37 runs <= 250 ms; closing the gap would need a native overlay, out of scope.
nodes.norm_label: key -> visible overlay latency target (<= 250 ms)

nodes.label: Memory target (<= 320 MB PSS after use)
nodes.norm_label: memory target (<= 320 mb pss after use)

nodes.label: Preloaded overlay windows
nodes.rationale: Kept over on-demand overlays because on-demand roughly doubled key->visible latency (481-575 ms).

nodes.label: Mutter focus-stealing prevention (stale _NET_WM_USER_TIME)
nodes.rationale: Re-shown overlays were refused focus; fixed with fresh X server time + present_with_time.

nodes.label: argv forwarding over single-instance D-Bus before GTK/Tauri start
nodes.rationale: Cut launch cost from ~85 ms to ~40 ms.
nodes.norm_label: argv forwarding over single-instance d-bus before gtk/tauri start

nodes.label: Non-active overlays wait for overlay:primary-ready
nodes.rationale: Gives the overlay under the pointer the IPC bandwidth first (fallback 500 ms).

nodes.label: Fixed M_MMAP_THRESHOLD = 1 MB
nodes.rationale: glibc's dynamic threshold put frames in per-thread arenas that malloc_trim can't release; fixed threshold returns frames to the OS at ~15 ms latency cost from page faults.

nodes.label: 16 MB frame IPC + putImageData bottleneck (~117 ms)
nodes.norm_label: 16 mb frame ipc + putimagedata bottleneck (~117 ms)

nodes.label: WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER=1 workaround
nodes.rationale: WebKitGTK aborted with EGL_NOT_INITIALIZED without it.

nodes.label: CI build matrix job (ubuntu-24.04, windows, macos)
nodes.norm_label: ci build matrix job (ubuntu-24.04, windows, macos)

nodes.label: SHA-pinned GitHub Actions
nodes.rationale: Actions referenced by commit SHA with version comment, for supply-chain safety.

nodes.label: create-release job (draft release + GPL sources)
nodes.rationale: One draft release for every build job to upload into; carries the source of the bundled GPL ffmpeg builds and library notices.

nodes.label: Direction A: Glass macOS-like (chosen)
nodes.rationale: Frosted translucent toolbar, round white handles, blue accent; looks at home on all three OSes and stays out of the way.

nodes.label: Direction B: Adwaita GNOME-native
nodes.rationale: Rejected: native on Ubuntu but out of place on Windows and macOS.

nodes.label: Direction C: Signal developer tool (monospace, lime)
nodes.norm_label: direction c: signal developer tool (monospace, lime)

nodes.label: Overlay options popover (timer, remember selection, pointer, mic)
nodes.rationale: On-the-spot settings live here, everything else in Settings; choices remembered between captures.
nodes.norm_label: overlay options popover (timer, remember selection, pointer, mic)

nodes.label: Done saves over the same file
nodes.rationale: So the path already on the clipboard still points to the edited capture (same rule for the video trimmer).
nodes.norm_label: done saves over the same file

nodes.label: Redact tool (pixelate/blur/solid, irreversible)
nodes.rationale: Pixels are replaced in the saved file so what's underneath can't be recovered.

nodes.label: Editor tool rail with single-key shortcuts
nodes.norm_label: editor tool rail with single-key shortcuts

nodes.label: Dashed red recording frame outside the area
nodes.rationale: Drawn just outside the recorded area, with the controls pill, so neither ends up in the video; screen is not dimmed so you can keep working.
nodes.norm_label: dashed red recording frame outside the area

nodes.label: Recording controls pill
nodes.rationale: For full-screen recordings it collapses into the tray icon after the countdown since it can't avoid being filmed.

nodes.label: Native tray menu
nodes.rationale: Drawn by the OS so it takes the system look on each platform.

nodes.label: First-launch takeover prompt
nodes.rationale: Asks before taking over shortcuts; macOS adds a Screen Recording permission step.

nodes.label: Settings as one scrolling page, no tabs
nodes.norm_label: settings as one scrolling page, no tabs
